I only saw one post doing a quick google search... (s)he suggested
that its possible...

So just to ask, Aabt Kindred cannot D action, but can they D action
themselves (hence turning it into a NON D action).

With that aside, we'd need motivation for people not to block it...
perhaps skin of the adder/trap would be enough? But who's afraid of
getting punched when they can end combat? Maybe it'd be enough to
influence them away from it... so the deck works like this:

10000 Aabt Kindred

Library 90 cards

10 BO
10 Free States Rant
3 Cyptic Riders
3 Consservative Agitation
6 Form of Corruption
5 Temptations
5 Atonements
11 Skin of Adder
11 Traps
9 Form of Serpent

Masters
2 CreepShow Casino
2 Opium Dens
4 Blood Dolls
2 Path of Typhon
3 Intercept Locations
4 Tribute to Master

And I'm sure there's decks exactly like this (I think Jay of Columbus
has one), but I just thought of doing it personally myself...

Now to get 10000 Aabt Kindred (and 2 CreepShow casino...).

~SV

news:f987c6cd.02052...@posting.google.com...

> I only saw one post doing a quick google search... (s)he suggested
> that its possible...
>
> So just to ask, Aabt Kindred cannot D action, but can they D action
> themselves (hence turning it into a NON D action).

Yes. Any normally-directed action that an Aabbt Kindred does
to its controller's stuff will be an undirected action instead
(and therefore legal). This applies to Temptation as much as
to "diablerize a vampire" or "Arson a location".

> With that aside, we'd need motivation for people not to block it...
> perhaps skin of the adder/trap would be enough? But who's afraid of
> getting punched when they can end combat? Maybe it'd be enough to
> influence them away from it... so the deck works like this:
>
> 10000 Aabt Kindred
>
> Library 90 cards
>
> 10 BO
> 10 Free States Rant
> 3 Cyptic Riders
> 3 Consservative Agitation
> 6 Form of Corruption
> 5 Temptations
> 5 Atonements
> 11 Skin of Adder
> 11 Traps
> 9 Form of Serpent

6 Form of Corruption is probably too many. Such a great
card, but you can only have one in play at a time. Try
4.

5 Temptations is probably a good number, given that there
aren't *that* many different undirected actions per turn
that you can do.

If it's possible to put in some Awes instead of/along
with some Bewitchings, that'd be good. And some Dramatic
Upheavals (about 3) as well for post-Cryptic Ridering.
Might be good to have more than just 3 ConAg/KRC, too;
these can be passed just by distributing the damage right
rather than being Cryptic, you know. You could also use
Charming Lobbies if you wanted.

I'd probably go down to about 9 Skin/Adder and 9 Trap and
7 Form/Serpent to make room for some of this.

> Masters
> 2 CreepShow Casino
> 2 Opium Dens
> 4 Blood Dolls
> 2 Path of Typhon
> 3 Intercept Locations
> 4 Tribute to Master

Be good to have some Presence masters to make the Awes
and Bewitchings better, too. And Charming Lobbies if
you play with them. I'd probably ditch Tributes for
them; Blood Dolls are probably good enough.

> And I'm sure there's decks exactly like this (I think Jay of Columbus
> has one), but I just thought of doing it personally myself...

I had a totally different Aabbt Kindred deck for a while
(Smiling Jack to oust, no votes, but similar combat and
blocking). It's kinda fun anyway, and very confusing to
your opponents (you can't take (D) actions and you're going
to oust anyone *how*?) but can in fact be hard to oust with.
:-)

Josh

> Now to get 10000 Aabt Kindred (and 2 CreepShow casino...).

btw, you'll probably only really need about 12 Aabbt Kindred.
;-)

Looks fun. ;)

> 10000 Aabt Kindred
>
> Library 90 cards
>

> 10 Bewitching Oration
> 10 Free States Rant

Free States Rant is kind of nice, though I'm not sure it's the best
choice. If you added Presence Masters your Kindred would be 5-cap and
do 3 points per FSR, almost making it worthwhile. You can't go wrong
with KRCs.

> 3 Cryptic Riders
> 3 Conservative Agitation
> 6 Form of Corruption

Too many. Nice card though.
Consider some Charming Lobbies. If you had those Presence Masters in
place, you'd get a couple extra points when you called votes, and if
they were blocked, you'd simply call them again. Also can help cycle
cards faster.

Masochism might be interesting as well. Combat defense and can be used
to pay for Serpentis actions/combat.

Perhaps a Restoration or two would be worthwhile for the same reasons.

> 5 Temptations
> 5 Atonements
> 11 Skin of Adder
> 11 Traps
> 9 Form of Serpent

Lots of nasty combat here. Perhaps a handful of Catatonic Fear in case
you run into some nasty problems.

> Masters
> 2 CreepShow Casino
> 2 Opium Dens
> 4 Blood Dolls
> 2 Path of Typhon
> 3 Intercept Locations
> 4 Tribute to Master

No need for Tributes. Presence Masters would be good here.
I think Khobar Towers, Al-Khubar is always a great card for the
FoS--essential if you plan to steal your opponents minions. I'm also
partial to Realm of the Black Sun and you may have the intercept to
deal with any attempts to remove it.

Good luck!

Charming Lobby you mean? It's an action requiring Presence;
you name a vote card in your hand which you're trying to
Lobby Charmingly for; if the CL is unblocked, you put the
vote card on the table (and draw to replace) and the referendum
described on the vote card is called (all as one action). At
inferior Presence, the next vote called (by anyone) passes
automatically; at superior Presence, as above and gain 2 votes
in the first referendum.

So it's cool in that (a) it works like a Cryptic, except that
everyone sees it coming, and (b) it gains you more hard-to-
vote-down votes for Free States Rant (if you have PRE).

I think you currently only have 88 cards in the deck; you
could put in two Charming Lobbies and try it out. :-)
